subject.title: [Bug]: embedded prompt cache breaks across room-event, policy, and Responses boundaries

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the linked PR's contract where protected tool schemas remain stable and model-visible while an immutable current-turn policy denies unauthorized calls before hooks and side effects?
rationale: Tests and live evidence support the design, but visibility-versus-authority semantics across core and plugin tools are a security boundary that automation should not approve without owner intent.

options.title: Approve stable visibility
options.body: Accept immutable pre-execution policy enforcement and proceed with final exact-head review and landing of the linked PR.

options.title: Revise the boundary
options.body: Request narrower trusted-internal grants, different snapshot persistence, or different plugin-tool visibility before landing.

recommendation.title: Approve stable visibility
recommendation.body: Accept immutable pre-execution policy enforcement and proceed with final exact-head review and landing of the linked PR.
